```{r}
# Install the ISLR2 package if not already installed
#install.packages("ISLR2")

# Load the ISLR2 package
library(ISLR2)

# Load the NCI60 dataset
data("NCI60")

# View the structure of the dataset
str(NCI60)

# Access gene expression data
head(NCI60$data[,1:5])

# Access cancer type labels
table(NCI60$labs)

```
```{r}
g.lab<-head(NCI60$labs,100)
g.data<-head(NCI60$data,100)
```

```{r}
data <- scale(g.data)
distance_matrix <- dist(data, method = "euclidean")
#complete

# Distance matrix


# Hierarchical clustering
hc <- hclust(distance_matrix, method = "complete")
hc <- hclust(distance_matrix, method = "average")
hc <- hclust(distance_matrix, method = "single")
# Dendrogram
#plot(as.dendrogram(hc),hang=-1 main = "complete")
plot(hc)
```
```{r}
plot(as.dendrogram(hc), main = "complete")
```
